personas.background: Grew up in Manchester, moved to London at 22 to study design. Met Dom and Marcus through the local scene. Has always been socially oriented and the group's unofficial event planner.

activities.value: prefers morning yoga to gym sessions

social.value: loves hosting and being the one who organises things

domain_specific.value: animated by ethical consumption and sustainability

preference_history.trigger: Watched a documentary about dairy farming, prompted by a conversation with Marcus about sourcing

speaking_quirks: strings multiple emoji together at end of message
starts messages with 'okay so' when sharing news

personas.background: From Liverpool, came to London for uni, stayed. Has been with Kezia for two years. The group's go-to for anything sport or fitness related.

activities.value: prefers high-intensity training over low-impact exercise

social.value: prefers active social plans over sitting around

preference_history.trigger: Knee injury sustained during a five-a-side game in session 3, forced to cut out impact sports

speaking_quirks: uses 'tbh' often at end of statements
makes sports analogies to explain everyday situations
drops subject pronoun at start of sentence ('Saw that coming', 'Need to sort this')

personas.background: Born in Leicester, moved to London after graduating. Met Felix at secondary school, reconnected in London years later. Introverted but fiercely loyal. Values one-on-one time over group settings.

food.value: no strong restrictions but dislikes overly rich or heavy food

activities.value: prefers solo or paired activities over group ones

social.value: uncomfortable in large or loud group settings, prefers small gatherings of four or fewer

preference_history.old_value: avoids large group events, usually makes excuses
preference_history.new_value: willing to attend and occasionally enjoys larger group outings
preference_history.trigger: Had a genuinely good time at Marcus's birthday dinner in session 5, which she had nearly skipped

speaking_quirks: uses precise, slightly formal vocabulary even in casual conversation
responds with single sentences that end in full stops
rarely volunteers information unless asked directly

personas.occupation: Head chef and co-owner of a neighbourhood restaurant
personas.background: Grew up in South London. Has been running his restaurant for four years. Has known Zara since they were teenagers in the same area. Loves talking about food, cooking, and culture.

food.value: obsessed with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients

activities.value: cooking for others as primary social activity

social.value: loves hosting big meals and events

domain_specific.value: experimentally inclined in cooking, enjoys challenging techniques and unusual pairings

preference_history.old_value: experimental and technically ambitious cuisine, complex multi-course tasting menus
preference_history.new_value: comfort-focused, simpler dishes that people actually want to eat every week
preference_history.trigger: A harsh critic review plus mounting exhaustion from the relentless creativity demands pushed him to simplify

speaking_quirks: uses food and cooking metaphors to describe non-food situations
often starts stories with 'honestly, the thing is...'
gives detailed sensory descriptions when talking about meals or experiences

personas.occupation: Social worker, children and families team
personas.background: Originally from Bristol, came to London seven years ago. Started dating Dom two years ago. Deeply empathetic and good at reading group dynamics. Joined the friend group through Dom.

activities.value: prefers in-person socialising to anything virtual

social.value: strongly values being physically present with people she cares about

preference_history.old_value: resistant to video calls as a substitute for seeing people in person
preference_history.new_value: accepts and actively initiates video calls with the group
preference_history.trigger: Moved to Bristol to be closer to family in session 6, making in-person meetups impossible for now

speaking_quirks: uses 'bless' as a reaction to both good and bad news
often asks follow-up questions showing she was paying attention
signs off messages with a warm affirmation or check-in

personas.background: Grew up in Leicester with Priya, both moved to London independently and reconnected through mutual friends. Analytical, occasionally aloof. Went through a breakup at the start of the year, which the group has been gently supportive about.

skills_list.skill: pub quiz knowledge across politics, culture, and history

food.value: classic European food, skeptical of food trends

activities.value: prefers individual activities (reading, running alone, climbing) over team sports

social.value: small group settings only, finds large social events draining

domain_specific.value: skeptical of food fads and wellness culture

preference_history.old_value: avoids team sports entirely, finds them pointless for adults
preference_history.new_value: joins Sunday five-a-side with Dom's group
preference_history.trigger: Neighbour persuaded him to come along once; after his breakup he found the social outlet more useful than he expected

speaking_quirks: ends statements with rhetorical questions ('Is it not?', 'Wasn't it?')
uses formal constructions ('I would suggest', 'One assumes') even in casual chat
never uses contractions when making a serious point

edges.history_summary: Met in freshers week in London, have been close ever since. Zara is the only one who can get Dom to talk about feelings.
Met at a design agency three years ago, hit it off over a shared dislike of open-plan offices. Zara appreciates Priya's directness.

edges.relationship_type: childhood friends from the same neighbourhood
edges.history_summary: Grew up two streets apart in South London. Marcus taught Zara to cook. She was his first unpaid taster when he started experimenting with menus.
Became friends when Dom and Kezia started dating. They get on well but the friendship is still relatively new.
Met through Priya. They clash on lifestyle values — Zara finds Felix dismissive of things she cares about; Felix finds Zara too enthusiastic. Both make an effort for Priya's sake.
shared_events: group dinners where they avoid direct conversation

edges.history_summary: Get on well but not close. Dom respects Priya's no-nonsense approach; Priya appreciates that Dom doesn't push for deep conversation.
Have been training together for six years. Dom is one of Marcus's first testers for new menu ideas. They have a standing Thursday-night arrangement.
shared_events: Marcus cooked for Dom's birthday every year

edges.history_summary: Together for two years. The group is aware of the relationship dynamics and tries not to take sides when they disagree. Kezia's move to Bristol is a major stress point.
Respect each other without being close. Felix is the reason Dom gets quiz night questions right. Dom is the reason Felix occasionally goes outside.
shared_events: Felix came to one football match

edges.history_summary: Never quite clicked. Priya finds Marcus loud; Marcus finds Priya hard to read. They are polite at group events but never seek each other out.
shared_events: group dinners where they sit at opposite ends

edges.history_summary: Kezia's warmth tends to draw out Priya slightly. They have had a few one-on-one coffees and Priya has opened up more to Kezia than to most of the group.
Known each other since age 11. Went to different universities but stayed in touch. The longest friendship in the group. Understand each other without explanation.
shared_events: both moved to London independently and reconnected

edges.history_summary: Like each other. Marcus appreciates Kezia's capacity to manage Dom's mood; Kezia enjoys the free meals. They bond over Caribbean food.
Both care about food quality, though they differ on philosophy. Felix respects Marcus's expertise even if he finds the natural wine enthusiasm a bit much.
shared_events: shared a table at a food festival

edges.history_summary: Barely know each other outside group settings. Felix is polite; Kezia is warm. No friction, just no overlap.
shared_events: group dinners and group outings only

group_norms.norm_text: We don't cancel plans with fewer than 48 hours notice unless it's genuinely unavoidable
Everyone brings or contributes something when we do group dinners at someone's place
We celebrate each other's wins in the group chat, no matter how small
